svg.text: she has friends, he has rent
Rob Hegarty takes his own life
New Year’s Eve — the strand ends
Connell → a year in New York
the two of them — the braid
STRANDS — the two leads are the two saturated ribbons
Thirteen columns: the twelve episodes of the BBC/Hulu series, then a coda. Rooney’s novel covered the same ground — January 2011 to February 2015 — in dated chapters. There is no film.

Above the spine: the social world. On it: Connell and Marianne. Below it: family, and the private. Where the two thick ribbons touch, they are together; where they part, someone else is holding on. Alan and Denise run the full width — off-stage in some episodes, never out of her story.
